ValidationRule.description: Work Order cannot move to In Progress until Site Readiness Check passes all 6 criteria, or COO waives.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "In Progress"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Site Readiness Check"), NOT(Site_Ready_Overall__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Site_Readiness_Status__c, "Waived (COO Only)")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: All 6 site readiness checks must pass before moving to In Progress. Pull the job and contact the builder if a check fails. COO override required for any waiver.
